name: The bid ceiling, and how the price moves after it is fixed
name_zh: 最高投标限价与合同价款调整、竣工结算
review_status: Drawn from the published national codes and from public statutory sources. Pending review by a Chinese cost engineer (造价工程师) before it is relied on for a tender.
references: 中华人民共和国招标投标法
中华人民共和国招标投标法实施条例
GB 50500-2013 建设工程工程量清单计价规范
description: A Chinese public tender is bounded from above rather than only from below. The employer publishes a maximum bid price computed on the same bill everybody is pricing, and a bid over it is rejected outright however good it is. After award, the code enumerates the grounds on which the contract price may move, which makes a variation an exercise in naming the right ground rather than an open negotiation.

ceiling.note: computed by the employer on the published bill and the prevailing cost information, published with the tender documents, and binding: a bid above it is non-responsive.

price_adjustment_grounds.name: quantity deviation beyond the agreed threshold
the work does not match the characteristics the item was priced against
price movement, by price index (价格指数法) or by published cost information (造价信息法)
a prime cost sum being fixed

practice_notes: The quantity deviation threshold and the adjustment formula are contract terms; the code offers a default rather than imposing one
A characteristic that was described wrongly is its own ground for adjustment, separate from a variation, which is why the characteristics are worth writing out in full at tender
Settlement runs to statutory review periods; a submission that misses them can be deemed agreed
